title: A lead on the left leg mirrored onto the right leg
why: The legs sit 40 mm either side of the body, the right one turned round (yaw 180). A plug on the left leg's outer face (x -35 in the world, facing -x) must land on the right leg's outer face (x 35, facing +x), and a waypoint on the body's top stays on the body, mirrored across x 0.
